question: Which goddess, as the ornament of the kula, should be meditated upon next?
premises: A subsequent meditative step is indicated.
The object is the great goddess Kālikā.
Kālikā is described as the ornament of the kula.
inference: One should then meditate on the great goddess Kālikā, the ornament of the kula.
plain_english: Then one should meditate on the great goddess Kālikā, the ornament of the kula.
